CweFindings.Name: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')
CweFindings.Description: The product does not neutralize or incorrectly neutralizes user-controllable input before it is placed in output that is used as a web page that is served to other users.
CweFindings.Explanation: In reports.jsp, several database-sourced values are rendered into HTML using bare JSP EL expressions (e.g., ${username} at line 12, ${report.reportType} at line 52, ${report.filedBy} at line 55) without HTML escaping. JSP EL expressions do not escape HTML characters by default. If a malicious value is stored in the Users.Username, ComplianceReports.ReportType, or ComplianceReports.FiledBy columns, it would be rendered as raw HTML in every officer's browser, enabling stored Cross-Site Scripting.

CweFindings.Name: Use of Hard-coded Password
CweFindings.Description: The product contains a hard-coded password, which it uses for its own inbound authentication or for outbound communication to external components.
CweFindings.Explanation: compliance.properties line 5 contains a hard-coded plaintext database password committed directly to source control. The ComplianceConfig.getDbPassword() method reads this value as the default when the DB_PASSWORD environment variable is not set, meaning the production database password ships embedded in the WAR artifact.

CweFindings.Name: Use of Obsolete Function
CweFindings.Description: The code uses deprecated or obsolete functions, which suggests that the code has not been actively reviewed or maintained.
CweFindings.Explanation: ComplianceConnectionFactory.java line 10 uses Class.forName() for JDBC driver registration (obsolete since JDBC 4.0). ReportsServlet.java line 17 uses non-thread-safe SimpleDateFormat as a static field (superseded by DateTimeFormatter since Java 8).

CweFindings.Name: Unsynchronized Access to Shared Data in a Multithreaded Context
CweFindings.Description: The product does not properly synchronize shared data, such as static variables across threads, which can lead to undefined behavior and unpredictable data changes.
CweFindings.Explanation: ReportsServlet.DATE_FORMAT (line 17) is a static SimpleDateFormat instance accessed by concurrent request threads without synchronization. SimpleDateFormat is not thread-safe; concurrent calls to DATE_FORMAT.format() at line 39 can produce corrupted dates or exceptions.

CweFindings.Name: Missing Release of Resource after Effective Lifetime
CweFindings.Description: The product does not release a resource after its effective lifetime has ended, i.e., after the resource is no longer needed.
CweFindings.Explanation: In SsoSessionService.resolveTokenFromAuthGateway() (lines 93-114), an HttpURLConnection is opened but never explicitly disconnected via conn.disconnect() in any code path.

CweFindings.Name: Missing Release of File Descriptor or Handle after Effective Lifetime
CweFindings.Description: The product does not release a file descriptor or handle after its effective lifetime has ended, i.e., after the file descriptor/handle is no longer needed.
CweFindings.Explanation: In SsoSessionService.resolveTokenFromAuthGateway() (line 93), the HttpURLConnection handle is opened but never explicitly disconnected, leaving socket file descriptors unreleased.

CweFindings.Name: Insufficient Logging
CweFindings.Description: When a security-critical event occurs, the product either does not record the event or omits important details about the event when logging it.
CweFindings.Explanation: No logging framework is present. All exception handlers are empty catch blocks. Security-critical events (failed auth, unauthorized access, report generation failures) go completely unrecorded, making incident detection and forensic investigation impossible.

CweFindings.Name: Use of Hard-coded Credentials
CweFindings.Description: The product contains hard-coded credentials, such as a password or cryptographic key.
CweFindings.Explanation: compliance.properties contains hard-coded SQL Server SA credentials (db.user=sa, db.password) committed to source control. These ship embedded in every WAR artifact.

CweFindings.Name: Missing Synchronization
CweFindings.Description: The product utilizes a shared resource in a concurrent manner but does not attempt to synchronize access to the resource.
CweFindings.Explanation: The static DATE_FORMAT SimpleDateFormat field is accessed in loadReports() by concurrent threads with no synchronization mechanism whatsoever.

CweFindings.Name: Data Access Operations Outside of Expected Data Manager Component
CweFindings.Description: The product uses a dedicated, central data manager component as required by design, but it contains code that performs data-access operations that do not use this data manager.
CweFindings.Explanation: All four data-accessing classes bypass a dedicated DAO/Repository layer and directly construct PreparedStatements and execute SQL inline within their business/servlet logic.
